verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique, attorney-led immigration law firm offering visa and green card legal services, not a software product. User-configurable background automations are a software capability and a category error for this kind of business. No evidence shows the firm ships any such tooling, and probes found no API or llms.txt.
